Centered in the upper portion of the page is white text in a casual, hand-lettered font style that reads 'TO ALL THE CHILDREN OF THAT DAY-' arranged in four lines. The text appears slightly irregular and organic, consistent with manga lettering conventions. In the bottom left corner, the page number '4' is visible in small white text. The overall composition is stark and somber, with the dark background creating a sense of weight or gravity that emphasizes the dedication-like text. The lack of panel borders and imagery suggests this is likely a title page, dedication, or transitional page within the manga.
